node.title: XR uniform families have canonical first-core peeling owners
node.statement: A deterministic peeling process assigns every block removed from a dense one-per-slope uniform split-pencil family one canonical pointed first-Maxwell-core/trade record. Rank-two pivots additionally carry their unique fundamental four/five-block circuit. The terminal unowned residual has size at most floor((2N-2a-1)/h), which is below the 8n^3 allocation. The remaining task is to count the possible classified pointed records, handle their rank-at-least-three branch, deduplicate collision components, and extend to nonuniform cells.
